items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: And we had the same fella Jimmy Pollard playing violin too. He used to play with his two over there.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. He told that funny story about him being on the Smoky Mary. Tell us about it.

We used to play at Millenburg for picnics out there. Those were only picnics. And Sidney Bechet, he was playing clarinet with us, you see. And well, and Manuel Perez was playing trumpet. And we had the same fella Jimmy Pollard playing violin too. He used to play with his two over there. And we'd play them picnics. Cause we used to take a man when needed a man on the picnic. We'd have extra man when needed, you see. And Sidney Bechet would get on that old Smoky Mary, you know, that running out the Millenburg and…
Well, speaking of that term Dixieland, I never did ask fast either. When the word jazz began being used here in New Orleans, can you remember?
